; Read by bb.py (scripts/bbclient/ui.py) and by the npx installer (lib/ui.js); the widest variant that
; fits the terminal is used (small from 55 columns, mini from 36), below that a one-line wordmark.
; Lines starting with ";" are comments. Do not put spaces at the end of art lines.
